deployments_detail.use: Robin — a proprietary, hyper-personalized AI co-pilot for store owners and managers, using tens of AI agents working in tandem to turn real-time store data into on-the-spot actions (manage inventory, anticipate stock-outs, streamline operations). Has its own production login portal at robin.loblaw.ca. [Loblaw (proprietary)]

Google Cloud Vertex AI platform scaled across retail functions — merchandising, supply chain and store operations — as part of Loblaw's transformation into an AI-native enterprise. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI)]

Blue Yonder machine-learning demand planning / forecasting deployed to improve forecast accuracy and product availability across the supply chain, building on 10+ years of Loblaw's demand forecasting process. [Blue Yonder]

AI-powered demand forecasting and inventory optimization across 2,400+ stores with models accounting for regional preferences, seasonal patterns and real-time supply chain signals; plus AI-enhanced personalization within the PC Optimum loyalty ecosystem and workflow automation / intelligent assistants for Shoppers Drug Mart pharmacy operations. [Loblaw (on Shakudo platform)]

ChatGPT Enterprise deployed to Loblaw corporate colleagues to boost productivity and innovation (analyzing data, video and image content). Builds on existing use of OpenAI models to build proprietary AI solutions. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise)]

Agentic AI solutions in supply chain management to improve inventory accuracy and optimize logistics — autonomous agents handling complex workflows with human oversight at critical decision points. [Loblaw (proprietary, on OpenAI/Google models)]

Loblaw Data Insights & Analytics (LDIA) platform evolution adding AI-driven capabilities, including an AI assistant that lets users ask natural-language questions for smarter, faster merchandising/supplier decisions (offered to suppliers/vendors). [Loblaw (LDIA)]
PC Express shopping app inside ChatGPT and Google Gemini AI commerce integration for grocery discovery/checkout

PC Express grocery shopping app inside ChatGPT — customers shop for groceries from Loblaw stores conversationally, exploring meal ideas, curating ingredients and selecting products from local stores. Billed as a first-of-its-kind app in ChatGPT for a North American retailer. [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

Shopping via Google AI Mode in Search and the Gemini app — Canadians can buy health, beauty and apparel products (incl. Shoppers Drug Mart) directly through conversational agentic AI. Loblaw described as Canada's first large retailer to offer this. [Google (Gemini / AI Mode)]

Microsoft Azure AI integrated into the PC Optimum loyalty program to break down customer-data silos and match members with personalized deals and offers based on preferences; established a machine-learning practice within Loblaw's digital teams on Azure cloud. [Microsoft (Azure AI)]

Shakudo unified AI operating platform — centralized runtime for Loblaw to build and run first-party AI/ML applications with full data sovereignty, unified governance, audit trails and data lineage. Serves as the foundation for AI development across the company (demand forecasting, personalization, pharmacy workflow automation, agentic AI). [Shakudo]
deployments_detail.value: AI built in-house serving 220,000+ employees; AI-powered operations across 2,400+ stores
